steps.title: Initialize Project Structure
steps.description: Ensure the basic HTML, CSS, and JavaScript files are in place.

steps.title: Configure App Metadata
steps.description: Confirm the app-meta.json defines the application's name and type.

steps.title: Set up Tailwind CSS CDN
steps.description: Verify the Tailwind CSS CDN is correctly included in index.html for styling utilities.

steps.title: Create Basic HTML Structure
steps.description: Ensure the <!DOCTYPE html>, head, and body sections are well-defined in index.html.

steps.title: Add Page Title
steps.description: Confirm the title of the web page in the <head> section of index.html matches the app name.

steps.title: Link Custom Stylesheet
steps.description: Ensure style.css is linked to index.html to apply any custom styles.

steps.title: Include JavaScript File
steps.description: Verify script.js is linked at the end of the <body> for any required interactivity.

steps.title: Implement Landing Page Container
steps.description: Define a central, responsive container within the body to hold the landing page content.

steps.title: Add Main Landing Page Heading
steps.description: Create a prominent and engaging title for the landing page, e.g., 'Welcome to Our App!'.

steps.title: Add Descriptive Subtitle/Paragraph
steps.description: Include a concise paragraph explaining the app's core purpose or benefits.

steps.title: Create Call-to-Action Button
steps.description: Implement an interactive button to encourage users to take the next step, e.g., 'Get Started'.

steps.title: Apply Tailwind Styling for Content
steps.description: Use Tailwind CSS classes to style the heading, paragraph, and button for a modern and clean look.

steps.title: Ensure Responsive Layout
steps.description: Confirm that the landing page adapts gracefully to different screen sizes using Tailwind's responsive utilities.

steps.title: Configure Backend API Schema
steps.description: Verify api_schema.json correctly indicates no backend functionality is required for this simple static app.

steps.title: Building welcomeapp
steps.description: The 'welcomeapp' project has been successfully updated to a simple custom landing page.
